verdicts.summary: Lean uses a different formula here. On the window Lean has 3/5 ≤ a, v_s ≤ 1 and projection ≥ e^{-8}/2 in place of these bounds; .7 ≤ a ≤ .9 is stated only up to the window's left end, and Q_s ≥ Q_min/2, E ≥ e_*/2 are not stated.
